description:
FILED s515c (Opus 5.5, 2026-10-11) while censusing Text-CSV-2.04 for the board widening.

MEASUREMENT HOLE in tools/cpan-scoreboard.pl: the per-file verdict is
    FAIL if ok == 0; PARTIAL if notok || rc != 0; else PASS
where rc is tools/run-dist-t.pl's OWN exit status (always 0 when it ran) -- not SBCL's, which run-dist-t prints on its `SBCL <TAB> rc` line -- and the PLAN line (also printed) is never compared with the rows that ran.  So a t-file whose program DIES after row 1 reads PASS 1/0.

MEASURED (main 973bdb1d, Text-CSV-2.04 alone, --jobs 2): 18 files read PASS with 1 ok where perl runs 8..25,119 rows -- 20_file 1/109, 21_lexicalio 1/109, 22_scalario 1/136, 40_misc 1/24, 45_eol 1/1094, 46_eol_si 1/562, 50_utf8 1/93, 51_utf8 1/207, 55_combi 1/25119, 65_allow 1/1119, 68_header 1/32, 70_rt 1/20469, 77_getall 1/81, 79_callbacks 1/113, 80_diag 1/345, 85_util 1/1448, 91_csv_cb 1/79, rt99774 1/8: the scoreboard's "23 PASS" for the dist is really 5 (01_is_pp, 16_import, 78_fragment, 81_subclass, fields_containing_0).  Every one of them dies at `require "./t/util.pl"` (#3061, the whole-file capture refusal) with SBCL rc 2 and an SBCL backtrace on stderr.  The PLAN line said 109 etc.

CONSEQUENCE: the row baseline (baselines/cpan-board14-fails.tsv) cannot see a file that dies early without a failing row; only the LOST check against a per-file table (`--board-baseline`) does, and only for the ok COUNT.  A whole dist can read "all PASS" while running 1 % of its rows.

FIX (tools only, one mechanism): run_one takes the SBCL rc from the `SBCL` line and the plan from the `PLAN` line; a file with SBCL rc != 0 or (a numeric plan, no skip_all, and ok + notok < plan) is PARTIAL (or FAIL at 0 ok), and `--rows` emits a synthetic `*SHORT*` row (got `ran N`, expected `planned M`) so the row gate sees a file that stops early.  It moves verdicts and adds rows on every board: land it with a re-bless of the per-file table and the `*SHORT*` rows entered BY HAND with causes, in one commit, on a quiet box.  Related: #1575 (the board does not chdir), #1501 (the companion's early-stop triage, the same idea).

CORRECTION (s515c, same day): under the BOARD those 18 Text-CSV files die at `require "./t/util.pl"` because the runner does not chdir (#1575) -- from the dist root they die one step later at the #3061 refusal.  JSON-PP-4.18-0 shows the same hole: 019_incr.t reads PASS 384/0 where perl runs 745, and its 16 099_binaryNN.t files (1,536 rows each in perl) are FAIL 0/0 behind #1575 (`do "./t/099_binary.pl"`).

=== DONE (s516b, member 2) ===
tools/cpan-scoreboard.pl: PASS = at least one ok + zero not-ok + the plan met + SBCL exit 0; a file that ran rows and misses either gets ONE synthetic row `dist t-file 0 *PLAN* "ran M of N, rc R" "N row(s)"` (`of no plan` / `a plan` without a plan line; R = SBCL's exit, 124 for a timeout); `*FILE*` stays for no rows at all.  Defined once (`shortfall`), documented in docs/cpan-release-plan.md (the runner's contract).  SECOND HALF: run-dist-t reads TAP from STDOUT alone, as prove does -- stdout and stderr shared one file and a newline-less stderr line (the runtime's "While evaluating the form ... :" context) glued HTTP-Tiny's done_testing plan onto its end, so 11 HTTP-Tiny files read "no plan".  Guards: tools/t/cpan-scoreboard.t 29 -> 31 rows over a new fixture tools/t/fixture-dist/t/dies.t (main reads it PASS 1/0); tools/t/run-dist-t.t row 5 (the glue).
Text-CSV verdicts (base -> tree): the 18 files that read PASS 1/0 now read PARTIAL with a *PLAN* row each ("ran 1 of 109, rc 1" ...) -- 17 die at `require "./t/util.pl"` (#3061's capture refusal, now that the file is found) and 15_flags.t dies at row 9 (#1747's `goto EOLX`, a compile error, PRE-EXISTING on main: it LOST 64 of s515c's 72 passing rows there).  Whole board: 32 PASS files became PARTIAL with a *PLAN* row; causes cited (#3061 #3023 #3281 #3282 #3283 #1576 #1747 NS) or queued under #3284 (11 files).
subject: MEASUREMENT HOLE: tools/cpan-scoreboard.pl calls a t-file PASS when its program DIES after row 1 (it reads run-dist-t.pl's exit, not SBCL's rc, and never compares the PLAN) -- Text-CSV reads 23 PASS where 18 of them ran 1 row of up to 25,119
